<!-- A new build: see CONTRIBUTING.md. -->

- [ ] One folder under `catalog/<section>/<name>/` with `source.schem`, `source.litematic`, or `source.schematic`
- [ ] `meta.json` with `author`, `source` (the page it comes from), and `license`
- [ ] The license lets paid servers build it (no non-commercial license, no “don't reupload”)
- [ ] No `build.schem` or `index.json` changes: CI makes them after the merge
